ei.title: The Life and Achievements of Alan Turing, a Mathematician and Computer Scientist

fullPassage: Alan Turing (1912-1954) was a brilliant British mathematician and computer scientist. Early in his career, he invented the Turing machine, an elegant mathematical model of a computer, which enabled him to take part in the construction of the Church-Turing thesis, contributing to the concept of computable problems. During the Second World War, he helped break the secret German code of the Enigma machine. This work was of considerable importance in leading the Allies to victory. After the war, he conducted research on the first computers. He developed an artificial intelligence test, the Turing test, based primarily on the ability of a program to deceive a human by presenting itself as human. During his last years, he made important contributions to biology in his work on morphogenesis in nature.

questions.passage: Alan Turing (1912-1954) was a (A)[brilliant / foolish] British mathematician and computer scientist. Early in his career, he (B)[invented / destroyed] the Turing machine, an elegant mathematical model of a computer, which enabled him to take part in the construction of the Church-Turing thesis, contributing to the concept of computable problems. During the Second World War, he helped break the secret German code of the Enigma machine. This work was of considerable importance in leading the Allies to victory. After the war, he (C)[conducted / avoided] research on the first computers. He developed an artificial intelligence test, the Turing test, based primarily on the ability of a program to deceive a human by presenting itself as human. During his last years, he made important contributions to biology in his work on morphogenesis in nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① brilliant - invented - conducted: Turing은 '뛰어난' 수학자였고, Turing 기계를 '발명했으며', 전쟁 후 연구를 '수행했다'는 원문 내용.
❌ ② foolish - invented - conducted: '어리석은'은 수학자이자 컴퓨터 과학자에 대한 긍정적 서술과 모순.
❌ ③ brilliant - destroyed - conducted: '파괴했다'는 Turing 기계를 발명했다는 맥락과 반대.
❌ ④ brilliant - invented - avoided: '피했다'는 전쟁 후 최초 컴퓨터 연구를 했다는 내용과 모순.
det.tip: brilliant(뛰어난) ↔ foolish(어리석은). invent(발명하다) ↔ destroy(파괴하다). conduct(수행하다) ↔ avoid(피하다)

questions.passage: Alan Turing (1912-1954) was a brilliant British mathematician and computer scientist. Early in his career, he invented the Turing machine, an elegant mathematical model of a computer, which (A)[enabled / prevented] him to take part in the construction of the Church-Turing thesis, contributing to the concept of computable problems. During the Second World War, he helped (B)[break / strengthen] the secret German code of the Enigma machine. This work was of considerable importance in leading the Allies to (C)[victory / defeat]. After the war, he conducted research on the first computers. He developed an artificial intelligence test, the Turing test, based primarily on the ability of a program to deceive a human by presenting itself as human. During his last years, he made important contributions to biology in his work on morphogenesis in nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ enabled - break - victory: 튜링 기계가 그로 하여금 논문에 참여할 수 있게 '했고', 독일 암호를 '해독했으며', 연합군의 '승리'를 이끄는 데 중요했다는 원문.
❌ ① prevented - break - victory: '막았다'는 참여를 가능하게 했다는 맥락과 반대.
❌ ② enabled - strengthen - victory: 독일 암호를 '강화했다'는 연합군 승리와 모순.
❌ ④ enabled - break - defeat: '패배'는 연합군 승리라는 원문과 정반대.
det.tip: enable(가능하게 하다) ↔ prevent(막다). break a code(암호를 해독하다). victory(승리) ↔ defeat(패배)

questions.passage: Alan Turing (1912-1954) was a brilliant British mathematician and computer scientist. During the Second World War, he helped break the secret German code of the Enigma machine. This work was of considerable importance in leading the Allies to victory. After the war, he conducted research on the first computers. He (A)[developed / abandoned] an artificial intelligence test, the Turing test, based primarily on the ability of a program to (B)[deceive / assist] a human by presenting itself as human. During his last years, he made (C)[important / trivial] contributions to biology in his work on morphogenesis in nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② developed - deceive - important: Turing 테스트를 '개발했고', 프로그램이 인간을 '속일' 수 있는 능력에 기반했으며, 생물학에 '중요한' 공헌을 했다는 원문.
❌ ① abandoned - deceive - important: '포기했다'는 테스트를 개발한 것과 모순.
❌ ③ developed - assist - important: '돕는다'는 Turing 테스트의 본질(속이기)과 반대.
❌ ④ developed - deceive - trivial: '사소한'은 important contributions와 정반대.
det.tip: develop(개발하다) ↔ abandon(포기하다). deceive(속이다) ↔ assist(돕다). important(중요한) ↔ trivial(사소한)

After the war, he conducted research on the first computers. He developed an artificial intelligence test, the Turing test, based primarily on the ability of a program to deceive a human by presenting itself as human. During his last years, he made ④<u>important</u> contributions to biology in his work on morphogenesis in nature.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① brilliant: '뛰어난' 수학자 — 원문 그대로.
❌ ② invented: Turing 기계를 '발명했다' — 원문 그대로.
✅ ③ build: 원문은 break(해독하다). 독일의 비밀 암호를 '만들었다'는 건 연합군 편에 섰던 Turing의 역할과 정반대.
❌ ④ important: 생물학에 '중요한' 공헌 — 원문 그대로.
det.tip: break a code(암호를 해독하다) ↔ build a code(암호를 만들다). Turing은 Enigma 암호를 해독해 연합군 승리에 기여.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① invented: Turing 기계를 '발명했다' — 원문 그대로.
❌ ② considerable: '상당한' 중요성 — 원문 그대로.
✅ ③ avoided: 원문은 conducted(수행했다). 전쟁 후 최초 컴퓨터 연구를 '피했다'는 것은 컴퓨터 과학자로서의 업적과 정반대.

det.tip: conduct research(연구를 수행하다) ↔ avoid research(연구를 피하다). Turing은 전쟁 후 최초 컴퓨터 연구에 참여.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① elegant: Turing 기계가 '우아한' 수학 모델 — 원문 그대로.
✅ ② reveal: 원문은 deceive(속이다). Turing 테스트의 핵심은 프로그램이 인간을 '속여' 자신을 인간처럼 보이게 하는 능력. '드러내다'는 정반대.
❌ ③ contributions: '공헌' — 원문 그대로.
❌ ④ biology: '생물학' 분야 — 원문 그대로.
det.tip: deceive(속이다) ↔ reveal(드러내다). Turing 테스트: 프로그램이 인간인 척 속일 수 있는지 판단.

questions.passage: (A) During the Second World War, he helped break the secret German code of the Enigma machine. (B) She accidentally dropped the glass and it broke into many pieces on the floor.
questions.stem: 밑줄 없이 제시된 (A)와 (B)의 break의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 해독하다 - (B) 깨지다: (A)에서는 암호를 '해독'한 것이고, (B)에서는 유리잔이 바닥에서 '깨진' 것.
❌ ① (A) 깨지다 - (B) 해독하다: (A)에서 암호가 '깨지다'는 부자연스럽고, (B)에서 유리잔이 암호를 '해독'할 수 없음.
❌ ③ (A) 부수다 - (B) 해독하다: (B)에서 유리잔이 해독할 수 없음.
❌ ④ (A) 해독하다 - (B) 해독하다: (B)에서 유리잔이 해독할 대상이 아님.
det.tip: break: 1. 해독하다(break a code) - 암호를 푸는 것. 2. 깨지다, 부서지다(break into pieces) - 물체가 조각나는 것.

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"To make someone believe something that is not true, often in order to get an advantage."

det.analysis:
✅ ① deceive: 사실이 아닌 것을 믿게 만드는 것 = 속이다. Turing 테스트의 핵심 단어.
❌ ② invent: '발명하다'는 새로운 것을 만드는 것.
❌ ③ conduct: '수행하다'는 활동을 실행하는 것.
❌ ④ contribute: '기여하다'는 무언가를 제공하는 것.
